title: Eagle Wing Tours
specs: Canada’s first carbon-neutral whale watching company
#1 on TripAdvisor since 2007, #2 Experience in Canada
Wild 4 Whales Foundation supports marine conservation
Anyone of any age and ability is welcome; youth under 16 must be accompanied by an adult 19+
Anyone under 19 must have a parent/guardian sign a release waiver prior to check in
Tours not recommended for people with serious neck/back problems or frail health
Vessels accommodate from 12 to 63 guests depending on boat

blurb: Guests board luxury semi-covered and open boats to watch whales, sea lions, eagles, and other wildlife in the Salish Sea. Tours include expert naturalist guides and a whale sighting guarantee. The company emphasizes conservation, education, and sustainability in all tours.
extraNote: Cancellation before tour; charters require 2 weeks notice · If no whales are seen, guests can join again for free with no expiration or standby · Fill out e-waiver online prior to arrival to speed check-in · Fisherman’s Wharf, 12 Erie Street, Victoria, BC · May through November for main tours; year-round availability for shoulder season tours
